question.html:
A ball is connected to a string that is attached to the ceiling of a truck. The truck accelerates to the right on a horizontal road. The string makes an angle of 30° with the vertical.


a.i

Draw a labelled free-body diagram of the forces on the ball.

[2]

a.ii Determine the acceleration of the truck. [2]

b The truck now moves at constant speed up an incline that makes an angle of 10° to the horizontal. State and explain the angle between the string and the vertical. [2]

c Calculate the maximum speed at which the truck can travel on this road. [2]

d

The truck runs out of fuel just as it enters the semicircle with speed 15 m s−1. The resultant force opposing the motion has magnitude 520 N. The mass of the truck is 1400 kg. A service station is at the other end of the semicircle.

Determine whether the truck will be able to reach the service station.

[3]
